_comment: Informal description (not validated by a JSON Schema engine) of a change card's Markdown format. lib/change_card_validator.py implements this shape directly with regex; this file is the human-readable reference for whoever writes the card by hand.

fields.label: For what
fields.note: this list is the kit's domain-neutral default hierarchy (config/project.json:property_order); a real project declares its own there

fields.label: What it risks
fields.note: free text except for the literal value "none", which Invariant treats as "explicitly declares there is no risk" (see mandatory_nonempty_unless_both_in)

fields.label: Invariant
fields.value_format: "n/a" (case-insensitive), or a comma-separated list of tokens matching <invariant_prefix>-\d\d (config/project.json:invariant_prefix, INV by default) or any of config/project.json:extra_invariant_tokens (ARCH-006 by default)

mandatory_nonempty_unless_both_in.note: n/a is only accepted if BOTH fields fall in this set; if either one is Data integrity/State correctness/Identity-uniqueness/Recoverability/Security/Performance, a real invariant is required

fields.label: Ticket
fields.value_format: a Jira-style key [A-Z]+-\d+ (e.g. DEV-123), or the literal "no ticket" (case-insensitive)

output.routing: opus | sonnet: opus if For what or What it risks fall under the project's critical properties (by default: everything except Auditability and UX)
output.fields_missing: sorted list of the 9 labels that are missing
output.errors: list of strings, one per detected violation

epistemic_coverage.tag_required_fields: how many of the 9 fields require a tag (7)
epistemic_coverage.tagged_ok: how many of the fields present carry a valid tag in the right position
